title: Split a job queue into fixed-size batches
objective: Implement chunk(items, size) so that every item lands in exactly one batch and the final short batch survives, without touching the caller's array.
audience: CS1 students who can write a for loop over an array index
concepts: empty input as a normal case
misconceptions: `i + size <= items.length` as the loop guard silently drops the final short batch
`items.splice(0, size)` empties the caller's array as a side effect
a size of 0 or 1.5 is never rejected, so the loop either never advances or returns fractional batches
